definitions.full: H2785. chartsannim חַרְצַנִּים noun masculine plural some insignificant vine-product, usually taken as grape-kernels, grape-stones , from acrid taste, so Thes (after Onk, Mishna), see also זָּג above: מֵח הַיַּיִן ׳מִגֶּפֶן וְעַדזָֿג Num 6:4 of the wine-vine, including both חרצנים and זג , he shall not eat. II. חרץ be yellow (probably √ of following: Syriac id. (rare), yellow ; compare Aramaic חריע safflower , Arabic id.: see Nö ZMG 1886, 728 , Löw Aramaic Pflanzenn. 218 Kö ii. l. 137 ).
